name: Hoppscotch
summary: Open-source API development tool for sending and testing HTTP, GraphQL, WebSocket and other requests, usable on the web, desktop and CLI.
use_cases: send an HTTP request to an API endpoint and view the response
query a GraphQL API and explore its schema
subscribe and publish to MQTT broker topics
generate request code snippets in other languages
features: send HTTP requests with any method
test WebSocket, SSE, Socket.IO and MQTT connections

Manage users and teams via admin dashboard

findings.summary: zip: Critical Parser Differential & Security Control Bypass via Dual-Header Inconsistencies (Zip Cloaking) Leading to Arbitrary File Overwrite & RCE
ZipStreamReader::extract() and ZipArchive::extract() apply Unix permissions through symlinks without confining the target

evidence: the project's source does not use ZipStreamReader::extract, ZipArchive::extract, but other packages depend on zip

findings.summary: rust-openssl has incorrect bounds assertion in aes key wrap
rust-openssl: rustMdCtxRef::digest_final() writes past caller buffer with no length check

evidence: the project's source does not use Deriver::derive, PkeyCtxRef::derive, but other packages depend on openssl
